race.comment: ABSTRUSE (1) demolished a good field two back in this class at Nowra with the 60kg. Couldn't follow that up in BM66 grade when she tired late to run ninth over 1020m at this track. Finds a suitable race and can bounce back quickly. CURLY BEND (6) comes here deep into the preparation and will appreciate the firmer surface. Sat on the strong tempo early before folding up in the straight when fourth over 1200m at Wagga. Look for a better performance today. OUR CIELO (7) got the Maiden win out of the way first up at Nowra, then came back to the home track with a fading seventh over 1200m at Kembla Grange. Fitter now and no surprise to see him take this out. VEREEVA (8) finally comes up with a good gate and expect to see her stalk the pace today. Slashing run when she came from near last on the turn to secure fourth over 1210m at this track. Gets the claim again and can go close.
